verdict.rationale: Shopify documents Cart MCP tools (create_cart, get_cart, update_cart, cancel_cart) as JSON-RPC calls against each merchant's /api/ucp/mcp endpoint under the openly published UCP spec, and create_checkout can convert a cart into a checkout session. A runtime probe created a real cart keylessly on Shopify's hardware store via the UCP CLI and got back a live Cart gid. missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of the update_cart path (only cart creation was exercised live).
